reference.source: One-group bare slab with D=1, Sigma_a=0.1, nuSigma_f=1, L=10 and vacuum/Dirichlet boundaries

tolerance.rationale: Predeclared 0.1% eigenvalue criterion; the fundamental slab flux is the secondary shape check.

sphere_reference.source: Bare sphere with D=1, Sigma_a=0.1, nuSigma_f=1, radius R=10 and phi(R)=0
sphere_reference.derivation: The spherical fundamental mode has geometric buckling B^2=(pi/R)^2, so k=nuSigma_f/(Sigma_a+D B^2).

convergence.note: Three slab and three spherical meshes verify the one-group diffusion eigenvalue; no transport/OpenMC comparison is claimed.
